project_type: Next.js 14 App Router monorepo — web app + shared packages (database, permissions, scoring, payments, game-rules, shared-types, tournament-engine)
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Web app scripts: 'pnpm --filter web dev' (Next dev on :3000), 'pnpm --filter web build' (runs 'prisma generate && next build'), 'pnpm --filter web lint', 'pnpm --filter web type-check' (tsc --noEmit). Root has no standalone build command.
test_framework: No test framework configured in apps/web. Verification is via type-check + lint + build.
build_command: cd apps/web && pnpm build   (or from root: pnpm --filter web build)
test_command: pnpm --filter web type-check && pnpm --filter web lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'pnpm --filter web type-check' from esports-platform root — must exit 0 with no errors. 2. Run 'pnpm --filter web lint' — must exit 0. 3. Run 'pnpm --filter web build' — must complete without errors. Do NOT restart the dev server.
snapshot_or_generated_files: prisma generate is run as part of build (prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma). No other checked-in generated files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell shell. Do NOT push to git. Do NOT restart the dev server if running. Always work in the worktree at d:\Discord Projects\Tournament-Bot\esports-platform. Relative paths must be anchored to that root.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow the existing code style: 'use client' directive where needed, Prisma queries only in server components/route handlers (never client components), all Date fields serialized to ISO strings before passing to client components, auth via createClient() from @/lib/supabase/server in server components.
key_patterns: 1. CSS-variable-first: colours referenced as var(--color-accent), var(--color-bg-primary), etc. everywhere. Never hard-code hex in JSX when a CSS var exists. 2. glass-card Tailwind utility class (defined in globals.css) used on all card surfaces; never replicate inline. 3. Framer Motion: fadeUp/fadeIn/staggerChildren/slideInLeft/scaleIn variants from src/lib/motion.ts — import and extend; never re-declare. 4. GlassCard/GlowButton/Badge/AnimatedCounter/StatusPulse are the core UI primitives in src/components/ui/ — build on them, not around them. 5. All admin pages live under servers/[guildId]/admin/[section] and use AdminSidebar from the admin layout. 6. ServerBrandingContext provides per-server --color-accent override from prisma.serverSettings.accentColor. 7. No @radix-ui/react-slot installed — GlowButton asChild uses a <span> wrapper. 8. Three.js scene is in HeroScene.tsx / HeroSceneWrapper.tsx; use dynamic import with ssr:false via HeroSceneWrapper. 9. Recharts is available for charts (AnalyticsDashboard). 10. lucide-react for all icons.
directory_structure: esports-platform/apps/web/src/ — app/ (Next.js App Router: all routes), components/ (ui/, admin/, tournament/, three/, analytics/, developer/, server/), lib/ (supabase/, motion.ts, utils.ts, realtime.ts), contexts/ (ServerBrandingContext). Packages: packages/database (Prisma client + schema), packages/permissions, packages/scoring, packages/game-rules, packages/payments, packages/shared-types, packages/tournament-engine.
